feeds.title: Tree of Life
feeds.description: Tree of Life remains the iconic bohemian brand of Australia, celebrating freedom of expression and creativity for starry-eyed dreamers everywhere.

feeds.title: Mahiya Blog
feeds.description: Featuring photos from our latest collections, bohemian style tips, travel info, and more, the Mahiya Blog is ideal for boho babes from all walks of life. Mahiya is an Australian fashion label featuring bohemian handcrafted leather bags, wallets, accessories & clothing.

feeds.title: Indie and Harper Blog
feeds.description: Indie and Harper is a Bohemian Brand that empowers women through Jewellery and much more. They educate through our blogs about the benefits of different gem stones like moonstones and turquoise. Indie and Harper also chat about the different Birthstone Jewellery and the benefits linked to them.

feeds.title: Cleobella Blog
feeds.description: Cleobella's handcrafted clothing, bags, jewelry and accessories are each individually made, creating sustainable incomes for artisans and families in Bali.

feeds.title: Kivari - The Blog
feeds.description: KiVARI is an Australian Boho-Luxe Fashion Label that caters to women full of adventure, travel and discovery. Quality leather, clothing, bags, and wallets.

feeds.title: Dreamers and Lovers Blog
feeds.description: Get inspired by other bohemian brides. You'll find loads of wildflowers, flower crowns, yummy cakes, and lots of vintage-inspired, and simple wedding dresses. Every Dreamers & Lovers' dress is an art form, designed and handmade in our California Design Studio.

feeds.title: Eva Catherine
feeds.description: Eva is an industry stylist, LA signed model, Fashion student, Designer, and creative director of this blog as well as an Instagram influencer. She is affiliated with LikeToKnowit & Reward Style as well.

feeds.title: GypsyLovinLight
feeds.description: This is a loving space for all to share, inspire and be inspired. A place for the magic makers, the dreamers and conjurers, the wild at heart, the love makers, the freedom seekers, the light workers, to all those who long to express their inner worlds through creativity and love. Within lies a gypsy soul and a loving light that shines right from my heart to yours.

feeds.title: LOVESTITCH
feeds.description: Lovestitch is women's Bohemian clothes & affordable California style sweaters, dresses, skirts, jackets, scarves, rompers, boho bags and more!

feeds.title: Boho and Flower
feeds.description: Hello! And welcome to my blog. Since you're here, I suppose you're as passionate as I am when it comes to boho chic style. Driven by passion and desire for everything that is boho, I studied the design course from the University of California, USA.

feeds.title: Van De Vort

Stylista comes from her passion for styling. She worked as a freelance fashion stylist for Miami Modeling Agencies. So, for the blog, she combined the two things she loves and created Chic Stylista.
